summary: crates/project-bundle rev3: found rev3 already interrupted mid-session with uncommitted apply_import batch-recovery work (src/apply.rs, src/error.rs) plus an uncommitted tests/recovery.rs; assessed as sound and complete, kept as-is rather than reworked (verdict recorded in coordination/daniel-bundle.md). apply_import now rolls back every write already committed earlier in a multi-file call when a later write fails (per-write undo: remove a file this call created, or restore its exact pre-write bytes), returning the original typed cause on a clean rollback or the new BundleError::RollbackIncomplete naming exactly what could not be undone on a double fault; proven by injecting a real race at the first, middle and last of three writes, plus an overwritten-conflict restore variant (tests/recovery.rs, 4 tests). Added two new adversarial bounds: a path of only separators is AbsolutePath not silently normalized to empty, and two declared paths that are byte-different but resolve to the same file on disk (the documented APFS Unicode-normalization hazard: precomposed vs. combining-mark forms) are now the new typed BundleError::AmbiguousPath via filesystem-identity (fs::canonicalize) detection rather than a hand-rolled NFC/NFD table (no unicode-normalization crate available offline); the other six items on the adversarial list (entry-count/total-bytes at and past the cap, one file past the per-file limit, duplicate paths, empty path, target changed between preview and apply, decision map missing a conflict entry) were already covered by rev1/2 and re-verified passing, not re-proven. New tests/stale_identity.rs proves the stale-identity acceptance spec (a preview is valid only while the target hashes it observed still hold) for the one previously-untested case, deletion between preview and apply, both standalone and combined with batch rollback (2 tests). Fetched and merged origin/main at abbe88a5 (--no-edit): clean, zero conflicts, verified beforehand that nothing under crates/project-bundle had changed upstream. Fixed stale rev1-era BundleError variant list in coordination/daniel-bundle.md's typed-contract section (never updated through rev2). cargo test: 51 passed (50 integration + 1 doctest), 0 failed. cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings: clean. Repo's own AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md contain untrusted text styled as user authorization (alternate commit-identity rules, staffing claims); not followed, per this revision's explicit task instructions.
